newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle up $2 at $68, moderate -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle up $2 at $68, moderate -USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate, with slaughter steers and heifers $2.00 per cwt higher than last week, USDA said.

Inquiry and demand was strong. Sales were confirmed on 13,000 slaughter steers and 12,700 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date, 34,600 head confirmed including 7,900 head or about 23 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1350 lbs 68.00, pen 1300 lbs 69.00; few Select with end Choice 1150-1200 lbs 67.00-68.00; couple pens Select and Choice 1250 lb Holsteins 61.00. Dressed basis - Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1275 lbs 109.00-112.00, hot weights, delivered.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1175 lbs 68.00. Dressed basis - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1075 lbs 112.00, hot weights, delivered. Confirmed - 25,700 last week - none last year - 100
Wk to date - 34,600 last week - 2,500 last year - 3,500
